## Slide 1

Beacon Hollow Works — Trade Start Logic Model WHAT WE PUT IN A fitted-out joinery workshop on the Beacon Hollow industrial estate Four qualified tradespeople release one day a week to teach WHAT WE DO A sixteen-week introductory joinery course for school leavers Employer site visits arranged in week twelve of every cohort WHAT WE MAKE Four cohorts of twelve school leavers trained every year Forty-eight employer site visits arranged annually WHAT CHANGES SOON Leavers can set out and cut a mortise and tenon unsupervised Leavers hold a current site safety card on completion WHAT CHANGES EVENTUALLY Leavers are still working in the building trades three years on Beacon Hollow employers fill apprenticeships locally rather than regionally
